rationale: Build on the 9x512 recurrent-tail winner with a minimal gated-carryover transplant instead of another LR sweep. Each reused tail block now learns a zero-init per-dimension carry gate that mixes the current deep state back toward that block's original decoder input before the shared block is applied again. This keeps the proven recurrent-tail/quant-aware endgame intact, adds only tiny float32 control tensors, stays compile-stable, and directly tests the underexplored gated-recurrence idea from the MLX/EvoNAS findings without paying for extra repeated blocks.
title: Gated Tail State Carryover On Recurrent-Tail Best
